title: The Kitchen of Sandpiper Point
author: Tamsin Quintana
blurb: Cyrus Villalobos, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must forgive the person in the mirror first before the bakery lease runs out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
